records.text: Strict alternating local extrema, protected-reference state machine, four post-break pivots, bounded range candidate, explicit age budgets, input identity/aggregation checks and continuation gating. Parameters are transparent test settings, not source quotations or calibrated trade rules.

Context includes symbol, timeframe and modifications such as session settings. Higher-timeframe requests can leak future values or repaint unless confirmation and availability are handled. The local helper uses explicit timestamps rather than implementing Pine requests.

corrections_proposed.issue: Three directional standard candles or a 2.5 ATR move are not sufficient proof of a swing-defined trend; 2.5 ATR movement and 3 ATR leg are different hypotheses.
corrections_proposed.proposal: Separate movement, leg, local extrema and protected structural trend; define a threshold profile before calibration.
corrections_proposed.disposition: separated in this engineering extension; original workbook unchanged

corrections_proposed.issue: Visual degree angles vary with zoom, aspect ratio and linear/log price scaling.
corrections_proposed.proposal: Use time-indexed, volatility-normalized slope if quantified strength is later needed; do not treat 45 degrees as scale-invariant balance.

corrections_proposed.issue: Three times range depth and 80 percent ranging are unverified generalizations.
corrections_proposed.proposal: Label as hypotheses, define range and sampling method, then test out of sample with costs.
corrections_proposed.disposition: no automatic target multiple or probability

corrections_proposed.issue: Four stalled candles alone cannot establish a higher-timeframe identity.
corrections_proposed.proposal: Review source timeframe and its own closed structure; retain original level identity.
